summary_method: Arithmetic means of two per-run summaries with reversed/balanced execution order, not pooled percentiles or an overall desktop-speed score. Every comparison uses its own identical harness on both images.
limitations: Synthetic unpaced server planning/FIFO/codec/protocol output to a discard socket. No capture, RDP transport, browser paint, Wi-Fi or physical input. Fixed codec mode bypasses automatic classification. Hash-enabled integrity and diagnostic-on records are separate from default-off, hash-disabled performance summaries.
encoding_caveat: Production quality, method, lossless and codec policies remain unchanged. Only automatic workloads with equal realized codec/pixel/byte-count/quality work across both versions and orders support equal-work timing claims. Fixed comparisons enforce equal realized work; separate encoded-payload fingerprints add non-cryptographic content evidence.
png_preparation_bound: Fused palette/index staging only when pointer table plus indices fit 64 KiB; 4 KiB stack prefix delays speculative allocation. Larger images retain palette preflight; high-color fallback remains Cairo. Existing WebP workspace cap unchanged.
